name: Are there sustainable or green building strategies that work well with historic properties?

mainEntity.name: Are there sustainable or green building strategies that work well with historic properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many historic buildings already embody sustainable principles through durable materials, passive ventilation, and thoughtful siting. Enhancing performance with targeted upgrades—like insulation in non-character-defining areas, efficient systems, and careful air sealing—can improve comfort while respecting historic fabric.
